recent.text: Test successful. Denver goes 4/16 from 3 in a 116-108 win at New Orleans. Nikola Jokic 26-8-10, 3 steals Jamal Murray 23-7-9, 2 blocks Christian Braun 17-7, 4 steals Marvin Bagley 7-7 in 13 minutes
recent.author: Bennett Durando
recent.quoted_text: The Nuggets are testing whether you can win an NBA game while pretending the 3-point shot doesn’t exist in 2026, and they might pull it off.

recent.text: Nuggets lead the Pelicans 56-51 at halftime. Nikola Jokic 12-5-5, Jamal Murray 10 points 4 assists, and six other Nuggets with between 4 and 7 points. They’ve attempted only nine 3s to NOLA’s 19, but it helps that the Pels have only made five of theirs.
